label: Bible Study
prompt: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like _____' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
verse: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
note: Hinds are female deer — sure-footed on cliffs where nothing else can stand.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Know ye not that ye are the _____ of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?
verse: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?
note: Paul tells the Corinthians they don't just visit God's temple — they are one.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And in the _____ watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
verse: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
note: The fourth watch was roughly 3 to 6 a.m. — the disciples had been out all night when Jesus came walking on the sea.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy _____; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
verse: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
note: Paul's 'O death, where is thy sting?' in 1 Corinthians 15 echoes this taunt of death.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I have _____ out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.
verse: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.
note: 'I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions' — sins gone like a cloud burned away by the sun.
